name: Vatic Pro Flash 16mm
description: The Vatic Pro Flash 16mm is a thermoformed unibody paddle with a raw T700 carbon fiber face that grabs the ball for heavy topspin. Its foam-injected edge walls enlarge the sweet spot and dampen vibration, making it a value-priced alternative to premium carbon paddles for intermediate and advanced players who want control-oriented spin.
care_instructions: Clean the raw carbon face with a carbon-safe eraser or a damp microfiber cloth to restore grit. Avoid abrasive cleaners. Store at room temperature; never leave the paddle in a hot car, as heat can degrade thermoformed edges.
